crossRefs.note: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.
This is the thing that you must do. A third part of you, who come in on the Sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites…
A third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation. All the people will be in…

people.name: Sur
people.line: Gate of the temple in Jerusalem

translations.web: a third of you shall be at the gate Sur; and a third of you at the gate behind the guard. So you shall keep the watch of the house, and be a barrier.
translations.bsb: a third shall be at the gate of Sur, and a third at the gate behind the guards. You are to take turns guarding the temple—
translations.kjv: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.
translations.asv: And a third part shall be at the gate Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, and be a barrier.
